name: Confederation of University Faculty Associations of BC (CUFA BC)
note: Musqueam, Squamish, Tsleil-Waututh, and Stó:lō Nations.
statement: We respectfully acknowledge our office is located on the traditional, ancestral, and unceded territory of the xʷməθkwəy̓əm (Musqueam), Skwxwú7mesh (Squamish), Səl̓ı́lwətaʔ/Selilwitulh (Tsleil-Waututh), and Stó:lō Nations.
